contract_scope.work_assumption: Total rows constrain GEMM FLOPs, but the expert histogram and active weight reads remain those declared by the case.

contract_scope.conditions: Context and execution geometry remain independent declarations; tensor equality does not identify a layer or verify/draft invocation.

semantics.structure: declared; absence of a measured event does not prove nonexecution
semantics.candidate: tensor contract match; not a verified layer assignment
semantics.bound: explicit occurrence evidence, Host connection plus tensor contract, or hash-verified synchronized module containment plus tensor contract
semantics.timing: measured clipped intervals only; no predicted costs or duration-based matching
semantics.aggregation: independent windows; node/layer/block unions are inclusive and not additive
semantics.subgraphs: declared semantic members share one measured boundary; member timings are not separately measured
semantics.implementation_correspondence: native types index independently declared implementation boundaries; this alone does not establish tensor compatibility or an occurrence
semantics.structural_classification: properties shared by all compatible declared targets; does not establish a layer or invocation
semantics.cohorts: identical declared contract and physical work on one placement; measured multiplicity and complete-event duration statistics without per-layer allocation; window counts do not establish step counts
semantics.candidate_refinement: source-defined optional tensor interfaces can narrow candidates; missing or unsupported descriptors do not select a bucket, and compression ratio, context and occurrence are not inferred
semantics.rank: physical rank is not a DP replica; only explicit placement filters candidates
